parsed.internal_thinking: Alice rolled a 5, which produced Sheep for Bob and Ore for Charlie. Alice has only 1 Wood and needs Brick, Wheat, and Sheep to build a settlement at Node 9 (she has the road 10-9). The robber is currently on Hex 5 (Brick 6), blocking Alice and Bob. Alice cannot build anything right now. She should try to trade for Brick or Wheat to progress toward Node 9. Charlie expressed interest in trading wood earlier, but Alice currently has wood. Alice will propose a trade to Charlie (who has Ore and potentially other resources) to see if she can get Brick or Wheat. Since Charlie just got Ore, Alice will try to trade Wood for Ore or Wheat, though Brick is higher priority. Actually, Alice has 1 Wood and needs Brick/Wheat/Sheep. Charlie has Ore/Wheat/Sheep. Alice will propose trading her Wood for Charlie's Wheat or Brick.
parsed.note_to_self: Rolled a 5. Charlie got Ore, Bob got Sheep. I have 1 Wood. Need Brick, Wheat, and Sheep for settlement at Node 9. Robber is still on my Brick 6.
parsed.say_outloud: Charlie, since that 5 just treated you to some Ore, how about we keep our momentum going? I've got some quality timber if you've got any wheat to spare for it.
